posts.title: Inventing Transformers
posts.description: A branching tech tree of the Transformer: the path of innovations from 2012 to 2017 - AlexNet, Word2vec, Attention, ResNet and more - drawn as glowing nodes on a skill-tree diagram, each one unlocking the next on the way to the architecture behind modern AI.

posts.title: The Myth of Deterministic Software
posts.description: How I've come to terms with LLM non-determinism in software and abandoned the comforting lies we've been telling ourselves about traditional software.

posts.title: More Thoughts on Falling Surplus
posts.description: The feeling of poverty amidst wealth stems from less opportunity to realize surplus. Bespoke goods are bid up, and market opportunities narrow for consumers & producers.
